Uses of Interface
hadur2.core.port.ProfileStore

Packages that use ProfileStore
Package
Description
hadur2
The Robocode adapter: the only code in Hadur 2 that sees the engine.
hadur2.core
Hadur 2's core: the whole of the robot's strategy, as plain Java that never sees the Robocode engine.
hadur2.core.memory
Opponent memory (stage S3): one OpponentProfile per opponent lineage, folded from each round's observations (MEM-2), encoded in a small checksummed binary format (ProfileCodec) and kept in a ProfileStore by the ProfileLibrary (MEM-1, MEM-3 to MEM-5, RES-3).
hadur2.core.port
The core's outbound ports: the only ways it reaches anything outside plain computation.
hadur2.core.replay
Recorded battles as text, and a driver that replays them through a fresh core (CORE-2).

    ProfileLibrary(ProfileStore store, int writeVersion)
